answer_2.quote: Objective assessment includes Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Frechet audio distance (FAD), and CLAP score to quantify audio quality. The Real-time Factor (RTF) is also introduced to measure the system's efficiency in generating audio for real-time applications.

answer_4.quote: We conduct crowd-sourced human assessments employing the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) to evaluate both audio quality (MOS-Q) and text-audio alignment faithfulness (MOS-F). ... The evaluations were performed via Amazon Mechanical Turk where participants were paid $8 hourly.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to rate audio quality and naturalness on a 20-100 Likert scale, and to judge text-audio alignment by answering whether the description aligns with the audio ('completely', 'mostly', 'somewhat') on a Likert scale.
